status_legend.missing: No production implementation exists in the fixed snapshot.
status_legend.partial: Reusable code exists, but the production path is incomplete.
status_legend.worktree-only: Visible locally but absent from the fixed Git snapshot.
status_legend.present: Implemented in the indicated tree; still subject to integration gates.
status_legend.intentional-exclusion: Deliberately unavailable until a separate enablement decision.

baseline.capability: durable per-settlement engine with journal, CAS, cursor and outbox
two-leg static composition and funding-order refusal
durable Linux Contracts Store with restart duplicate and equivocation handling
durable Linux relay queue with SQLite WAL and exclusive owner lock
digest-committed chain profile schema with EVM address and code-hash pins

requirements.gap: No durable route-level state machine owns both settlements and their economic completion.
acceptance_tests: a composed route reaches two terminal economic outcomes without manual calls
every route decision is replay-deterministic and emits effects only after commit
a nonterminal error enters recovery-only mode rather than abandoning locked funds

requirements.gap: There is no route journal/snapshot/outbox/timer store spanning both settlement stores.
acceptance_tests: event, snapshot, exact command or external-custody commitment and timer commit atomically
journal replay equals the materialized route snapshot
route store never persists a standalone adaptor scalar

requirements.gap: No long-lived production binary opens authorities, restores routes, ticks engines and supervises workers.
acceptance_tests: daemon restarts with open routes and resumes before accepting new work
critical worker exit fails health and starts the recovery lane
ordered shutdown drains durable writes while preserving refund and urgent-claim work

requirements.gap: Scalar verification exists, but no automatic, restart-safe downstream-to-upstream handoff exists.
acceptance_tests: mempool or broadcast exposure irreversibly moves secret visibility to Public even across reorg
restart re-extracts t from exact public evidence, verifies t*G equals T and claims upstream
plaintext t never appears in route state, logs, metrics or crash reports

requirements.gap: Static funding order does not provide a fresh, one-shot all-leg authorization immediately before revealing t.
acceptance_tests: reorg, stale snapshot, RPC uncertainty, insufficient action budget or changed terms deny reveal
authorization binds route, both legs, T, exact action digest, actor, expiry and one-shot nonce
TOCTOU revalidation occurs immediately before the secret-bearing action leaves custody

requirements.gap: Adapters implement observation/effect traits, but no permanent worker drives them or distinguishes outage from an empty scan at system level.
acceptance_tests: DOM, EVM and Bitcoin observers continuously persist canonical cursors and reorg records
RPC failure advances neither cursor nor economic state
worker backoff remains below the route's committed action budget

requirements.gap: There is no cross-chain actuator service owning broadcast, nonce, fee, replacement, rebroadcast and reconciliation policy.
acceptance_tests: restart reconciles exact transaction identity before any resend
EVM replacements preserve nonce, to, value and calldata while changing only allowed fee fields
Bitcoin funding fee bump cannot invalidate a presigned refund or silently change the bound outpoint

requirements.gap: The relay has in-memory and durable queue libraries but no authenticated network-facing service, discovery or backpressure layer.
acceptance_tests: remote submit and mailbox APIs preserve exact durable ACK semantics across restart
authentication, quotas, bounded payloads and backpressure resist unauthenticated exhaustion
relay loss never removes a participant's claim or refund authority

requirements.gap: No worker feeds accepted opaque route payloads into ContractsSessionStoreV1 and returns durable outcomes.
acceptance_tests: accepted payload bytes reach accept_transport_message byte-identically
F6 and route messages consume one shared durable TranscriptStateV1 watermark
duplicate, reorder, gap and equivocation retain their classification after daemon restart

requirements.gap: No authenticated user/operator API exposes route creation, approval, status and recovery without granting raw signer access.
acceptance_tests: API authorization is route- and method-scoped
status responses redact keys, nonces, t and raw confidential artifacts
manual recovery cannot bypass funding, reveal or refund gates

requirements.gap: The DOM wallet can reserve ordinary spends, but does not expose a route-bound authority for shared output, collaborative proof, refund and adaptor claim sessions.
acceptance_tests: selected DOM outputs are exclusively reserved by route and restored after crash
shares and nonce capabilities are bound to session, terms, purpose and exact templates
wallet can complete and rebroadcast claim or refund without exporting seed or raw signing share

requirements.gap: The EVM adapter deliberately emits only UnsignedEvmCall; no production signer, account-nonce or allowance authority consumes it.
acceptance_tests: signer verifies chain, code hash, account, exact call and route authorization before signing
nonce allocation and EIP-1559 replacement recover across concurrent routes and restart
ERC-20 approval is exact/bounded and cannot authorize an unprofiled token or spender

requirements.gap: The live Bitcoin custody boundary exists as a library, but no production caller owns it for an entire route lifecycle.
acceptance_tests: funding bytes are unavailable until the exact refund is durably armed
Bitcoin Core wallet identity, network, selected UTXOs and outpoint are revalidated on restart
claim/refund fee policy remains executable near deadline without nonce reuse

requirements.gap: There is no common least-authority protocol between route decisions and DOM/EVM/Bitcoin signers.
acceptance_tests: capability binds route, leg, action, exact digest, policy, expiry and monotonic use counter
signers reject arbitrary calldata, arbitrary transactions and cross-route replay
external-custody completion stores only public transaction identity and commitment in route state

requirements.gap: Wallet restore and backup do not reconcile open interoperability routes, reservations and external-custody actions.
acceptance_tests: restore during each open-route phase reconstructs or fails into a funded recovery lane
no restored output can be double-reserved by ordinary wallet and route wallet paths
backup age and missing signer authority are detected before accepting new routes

requirements.gap: The fixed Git snapshot contains no contracts tree; local ConditionLock sources and tests are not a branch deliverable.
requirements.target: contracts/src and contracts/test as tracked release inputs
acceptance_tests: clean checkout builds and runs all Foundry tests with pinned dependencies
Rust adapter vectors match tracked Solidity bytecode and ABI
contract source, build settings and artifacts reproduce the pinned runtime code hash

requirements.gap: No release registry publishes deployed address, start block, ABI/version, compiler settings and runtime code hash for an enabled network.
acceptance_tests: daemon refuses address, chain, start block or extcodehash mismatch before route creation
deployment manifest is signed, versioned and reproducible from tracked sources
proxy or mutable implementation is rejected unless explicitly represented and pinned

requirements.gap: Contract availability is not connected to an executable asset, allowance, payout, gas and DOM treasury-output policy.
acceptance_tests: v1 can be restricted to native assets and an explicit reviewed token allowlist
gas headroom and deferred withdrawal are monitored and exercised for hostile recipients
the confidential DOM treasury output binds amount and the pinned treasury recipient, not only a numeric fee

requirements.gap: F4 models a bond on ConditionLock, but no live authority funds, observes, releases, slashes and compensates it for solver quotes.
acceptance_tests: a quote is admissible only after independently verified live collateral reservation
one collateral unit cannot back two concurrent quotes
release, slash and compensation execute on the live lock and reconcile after relay loss or restart

requirements.gap: There is no independent production audit/deployment verification record for the locally added EVM locks.
requirements.target: independent contract audit plus reproducible deployment gate
acceptance_tests: independent review closes all high and critical findings
invariant, fuzz, differential and hostile-token suites run against final bytecode
verified source and runtime bytecode match every enabled deployment

requirements.gap: ReferenceSolverV1 prices and signs one RFQ but no service receives RFQs, owns policy and participates through settlement completion.
acceptance_tests: fixed-inventory solver quotes, signs, reserves and completes one live route without manual intervention
quote expiry releases reservations durably
solver restart cannot issue a quote before replaying inventory and open obligations

requirements.gap: Bond reservation IDs do not reserve real DOM, EVM or Bitcoin inventory across routes.
acceptance_tests: real balances, UTXOs and DOM outputs are atomically reserved per quote/route
concurrent quote race cannot overbook inventory
terminal, expiry and failed-pre-funding paths release only the correct reservation

requirements.gap: Pricing uses a static operator rate; no market-data provenance, staleness, exposure or spread-risk policy exists.
acceptance_tests: stale or contradictory market inputs stop new quotes without stopping recovery
per-asset, per-chain and aggregate exposure caps are enforced
quote records bind pricing-input digest, policy version and validity window

requirements.gap: No external venue or rebalancing adapters exist; this is optional for a funded bilateral solver but required for scalable commercial liquidity.
acceptance_tests: venue failures never mutate settlement truth
reservation and hedge executions are idempotent and exposure-capped

requirements.gap: ChainProfileV1 is a validated value type, not a signed operational registry with loading, rollout, revocation and startup verification.
acceptance_tests: every route freezes exact profile and deployment digests
unknown, unsigned, expired or rollback registry versions fail before external effects
RPC genesis/network identity and deployed code are checked against the frozen entry

requirements.gap: Separate feature tests do not prove that one production binary contains every required real backend and excludes laboratory surfaces.
acceptance_tests: release binary depends non-optionally on real DOM, EVM HTTP, Bitcoin live and production stores
evidence-only, fault injection, mock success and test keys are absent from the release feature graph
artifact publishes source commit, Cargo.lock, features, target, compiler and contract/profile digests

requirements.gap: Contracts Store and durable relay authority are Linux-only, but no authenticated sidecar boundary is defined for desktop/mobile wallets.
acceptance_tests: v1 declares Linux as the only authority host and rejects unsupported in-process operation
Unix-socket or mutually authenticated remote channel enforces user, route and method scopes
loss of UI/client cannot stop daemon recovery of already funded routes

requirements.gap: Bitcoin mainnet is unrepresentable and Ethereum chain id 1 is rejected; real-mainnet enablement requires a separate threat model and audit.
requirements.target: future versioned network profiles after testnet production closure
acceptance_tests: explicit governance decision names enabled mainnets and risk limits
independent audit and disaster rehearsal pass against exact release artifacts

requirements.gap: No automated daemon-owned DOM-to-EVM route exercises real wallet authorities and tracked deployed contracts.
acceptance_tests: fresh DOM regtest and Anvil processes complete claim and refund routes through the daemon
no fixed test key or shell-driven manual step exists in the product path
receipts, finality, reorg and restart are correlated to the correct route

requirements.gap: Live Bitcoin component tests exist, but no daemon-owned DOM-to-Bitcoin route uses real DOM wallet and Bitcoin authorities end to end.
acceptance_tests: fresh DOM regtest and Bitcoin Core regtest complete claim and refund through the daemon
refund is durably executable before funding becomes broadcastable
restart at each Bitcoin custody boundary converges without nonce reuse

requirements.gap: A manually invoked mixed-chain harness proves cryptographic handoff, not an autonomous multi-process EVM-DOM-Bitcoin route.
acceptance_tests: separate initiator, solver, relay, daemon, DOM, EVM and Bitcoin processes complete the route
the same T binds both settlements and t is obtained only from the designated reveal path
all processes can restart and every funded leg reaches claim or refund

requirements.gap: Component crash/reorg tests do not cover every route-level write, broadcast, reveal and recovery cut across real processes.
acceptance_tests: SIGKILL after every durable write and external handoff converges
relay loss/duplication/reorder, RPC outage, node restart, mempool eviction and bounded reorg converge
post-secret reorg never returns the route to a secret-private or passive state

requirements.gap: No system test proves process exclusivity, fencing and backup restore while money is locked.
acceptance_tests: two executors cannot dispatch the same route under distinct fencing generations
stale worker completion cannot acknowledge a newer generation's command
restored backup reconciles chain truth before signing or broadcasting anything

requirements.gap: Secret-redaction practices exist in types, but no release-wide artifact/log/store scanner proves route secrets and nonces are absent.
acceptance_tests: canonical artifacts are checked read-only across text, SQLite/WAL, structured logs and crash dumps
seeds, private keys, secret nonces, signing shares and standalone t fail the gate without being echoed
public SID, txid, pubkey, T and already-public chain transaction evidence remain distinguishable

requirements.gap: No route-level metrics, health model or urgent alerts exist for deadlines, stuck transactions and public-secret exposure.
acceptance_tests: DownstreamSecretPublicButUpstreamUnclaimed triggers highest-severity alert and shortest retry lane
health fails on stale observers, outbox backlog, signer loss, registry mismatch and insufficient action budget
metrics and logs contain identifiers/digests but no protected material

requirements.gap: No tested backup, disaster recovery, schema migration and key-rotation procedure covers route, wallet, vault, relay and deployment state together.
acceptance_tests: consistent backup set records component identities, revisions and profile digests
restore rehearsals recover open funded routes before new work
upgrade/downgrade and partial migration fail closed without losing refund authority

requirements.gap: Transport bounds exist, but no service-level admission, rate limiting, identity lifecycle, revocation or key rotation exists.
acceptance_tests: per-identity and global quotas bound CPU, storage and mailbox retention
rotation cannot rewrite an active route roster and revocation has explicit active-route semantics
reconnection and replay preserve transcript continuity

milestones.name: durable runtime skeleton
milestones.exit: simulated claim/refund/crash routes converge through the product binary

milestones.name: one real vertical settlement
milestones.exit: DOM-EVM and DOM-Bitcoin claim/refund paths run automatically on fresh test networks

milestones.name: composed route and operational solver
milestones.exit: a fixed-inventory solver completes EVM-DOM-Bitcoin without manual intervention

milestones.name: adversarial production gate
milestones.exit: all fault, recovery, security and operations gates pass on the exact release artifact
